question: What situation in the temple is addressed by the earlier instruction to the divine sages?
premises: The temple is the location concerned.
The temple is broken in every way.
The instruction refers back to what was said before.
inference: When the temple is completely broken, the earlier instruction applies, O divine sages.
plain_english: O lords among gods and sages, when the temple is broken in every way, the rule is as stated before.
